tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro snying thig gi kha byang bzhugs lags soḥ
༄༅/ /mkha' 'gro snying thig gi kha byang bzhugs lags soḥ

tei:div.tei:p: bzhugs lags soḥ :ḍanāg: e maḥ bdag 'dra mtsho rgyal bud med blo dman yang : bla ma sprul pa'i sku yi thugs rjes bzung : gsang sngags zab mo rdzogs chen lam la zhugs: khyad du 'phags pa snying thig gdams pa gnang : de yi chos bka' tshang bar bya ba'i phyir: ma bu'i dkar chag phyi rabs don du bri: ma 'ongs las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: rgya rgya rgya: yang gsang khyad 'phags gdams skor dang po la: btags grol rgyud kyi ma bu bstan pa ni: btags grol dang ni gcig shes kun grol dang : yang ti'i rgyud dang sangs rgyas sras gcig dang : rang byung rgyud dang yongs rdzogs chen po'i rgyud: rgyud drug ma yin bu ni rnam pa drug: btags grol ti ka gsal byed don snying dang : kun grol ti ka gsal byed me long dang : yang ti'i ti ka gsal byed shel snying dang : sras gcig ti ka gsal byed nor bu'i phreng : rang byung ti ka gsal byed dung spar khab: yongs rdzogs ti ka gsal byed dri med dang : de ltar ma bu bcu gnyis dag gis btags grol rgyud 'grel rdzogs: de yi phran la lo rgyus rtsal dbang dang : rgyud kyi bcang thabs gzhan don rtags bstan dang : yon tan byung tshul che ba bstan pa dang : 'das rjes gsum dang don khrid bcas pa ste: bcu gnyis bcu gcig phran dang bcas pa dang : dum bu nyer gsum dag gis btags grol ma bu tshang: de las mang nyung byung na lhag chad yin: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces: rgya rgya rgya: dbang dang lag len dag gi ma bu ni: rigs lnga phyi nang gnyis kyi sgrub pa dang : spros bcas bum pa'i dbang dang gsum pa'i lag len dang : dbang gsum sa bcad ḍākki'i mngon rtogs dang : dbang gi rgyab yig khyad par dbang lnga dang : mchod 'bum las byang gnyis te ma bcu yin: de yi bu ni dbang sgrub bum sgrub dang : dkyil 'khor rnam dag tshogs mchod gtor ma dang : ḍākki'i tshogs mchod dbang gsum tho yig dang :

gsang dbang shes rab dbang gi lhan thabs dang : ḍākki srog tig spyi gnad bla rdo dang : ḍākki nor sgrub dang ni dum bu bcu gsum ste: de ltar nyer gsum dag gis lag len ma bu grub: de las mang nyung byung na lhag chad yin: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces: rgya rgya rgya: khrid kyi ma bu gnyis kyi grangs bstan pa: thod rgal lam khrid nor bu'i snying po dang : de yi ti ka gsal byed sgron me dang : khrid rgyab lung gi phreng ba ma gsum yin: de yi bu ni lag khrid rtags tshad do: ma gsum bu gnyis khrid kyi lag len grub: de las mang nyung byung na lhag chad yin: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces: rgya rgya rgya: de dag rnams kyi rgyab chos bstan pa ni: snying thig chen mo don gsal me long dang : rnal 'byor bzhi dang zhus len ḍākki'i zhal gdams so: de yi bu ni ngo sprod lam 'bras dang : zhal gdams gnad thig rdo rje chu 'thung dang : ma lnga bu bzhis chos kyi rgyab yig tshang : de las mang nyung byung na lhag chad yin: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces: rgya rgya rgya: bar do dag gi ma bu bstan pa ni: zhi ba bar do khro bo bar do dang : 'chi ltas ngo sprod lam khyer rnam pa gsum: ma gnyis bu gsum dag gis bar do grub: de las mang nyung byung na lhag chad yin: de yi phyir na gsang ba'i kha byang gces: rgya rgya rgya: 'di yi cha lag gtum mo'i gdams pa dang : rdo bcud bdud rtsi rdo yi bcud len gnyis: lto gos zhen pa gcod phyir dgos pa yin: bka' srung srog sgrub rgyud dang gdams pa dang : 'gyu dus thun drug bla rdo cho 'phrul dang : de dag rnams la lhag chad med pa yis: mkha' 'gro snying thig gdams pa'i kha byang rdzogs: snying thig zab mo'i gdams pa 'chal dogs pas: lhag chad med par kha byang nyid la mnan: skal ldan las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: athi+-i: ཿ ༄༅: ཿe ma ho o rgyan padma nga :

pha med ma med me tog padma'i bu: rus med rigs med rgya mtsho'i gting du skyes: phyi med nang med 'od gsal ngang du gnas: rtsub 'gyur tshal gyi dur khrod du: mkhas pa shrī sing ha la: bco brgyad rgyud dang de 'grel dang : rdzogs chen gdams pa bcas pa zhus: blo can mya ngan 'da' don du: g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu: lha lcam manda ra ba la: sgrub sde mo ni bcol nas su: 'di nyid bsgoms pas zag bcas kyi: sgyu ma'i phung po yal nas kyang : zag med sgyu ma'i sku 'di la: rang bzhin ma grub skye shi bral: rgyud kyi khong snying gdams par phyung : g.ya' ri gong du yi ger btab: rgyud dang gdams pa kun khyer nas: 'gro ba'i don du bod du 'ong : mnga' bdag rgyal po la sogs pa'i: skal ldan slob bu mang lags kyang : tshig tsam rlung phyogs zag pa med: bi ma mi tra 'byon dgongs nas: snying thig bstan pa khong gis skyong : gdul bya khong gi dus la bab: bdag ni lha srin 'dul dus bab: padma bdag gi snying thig bstan pa ni: tshe lo lnga bcu kha ral gyi dus su snying thig snga 'gyur 'chal te nub tu nye ba'i dus na: mnga' bdag gi sras mo lha lcam padma gsal gyi: lo brgyad la tshe'i dus byas pa'i dus na: snying thig gi bswe sgrom spyi bor bzhag nas smon lam btab pas mo'i chos skal du sbed dgos gsungs te: mo skye ba 'ga' zhig brgyud pa'i tha ma la mi lus len: de nas bdag gi gsung gi sprul pas rjes su 'dzin: skye ba de'i rting ma la: snying thig man ngag gi gter ma dang mjal de'i dus su 'gro don rgya chen po mi 'ong yang : 'brel tshad don ldan yin: 'on kyang chos dang smon lam 'brel pa bdun cu 'ong : zab mo'i gnad 'brel bdun gsum 'byung ste: de min mi 'byung nyams su longs la gter du sbos: mtsho rgyal khyod la gtad pa yi: ku su lu yi gdams skor 'di: ti sgro'i brag la yi ger btab:

dang lung ldang lha'i brag la gter du gtams: padma las 'brel rtsal gyis gter sgo 'byed: de dus 'gro don rgya chen mi 'byung yang : phyi ma 'gro don dpag tu med pa 'grub: kun tu bzang po klong gsal nyi ma dang : bco brgyad rgyud dang gdams par bcas pa rnams: bum thang seng ge'i rdzong la gter bu sbed: dri med 'od zer gter de'i sgo dbye ste: bstan pa lo ni bdun cu don gsum skyong : de sras zla ba grags pas kyang : bstan pa lo ni dgu bcu skyong : de nas sprul pa chos dbyings sdud: smon lam 'brel pa stong rtsa brgyad: zab mo'i gnad 'brel brgya rtsa brgyad: 'gro don skyong ba sum cuu 'o: gter kha grangs kyang mang bar 'byed: skye ba de la mngon rdzogs nas: zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo ru: u rgyan nga yi spyan sngar ni: lhag ma med pa mngon sum du: skye ba de la 'tshang rgya 'o: o rgyan padma bdag nyid kyis: chos gter kha byang bstan par bya: ljongs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su: gter kha bye ba dgu khri sbas: phra mo rtsis las 'das pa sbas: chos gter khri dang nyer lnga sbas: nor gter brgya dang rtsa brgyad sbas: gter chen brgya dang rtsa brgyad sbas: thugs gter lnga la sogs pa yi: gter kha ji snyed sar sbas kyang : gdams pa'i mthar thug yang dag pa: 'di min sbas re na ra kan: snyigs dus rtsub 'gyur dus byung tshe: 'phrad chog man ngag snying thig 'di: nga yi thugs sras shes rab blo dang ldan: padma las 'brel rtsal dang 'di 'phrad shog: dwags po dang lung zhes bya ba'i: phu shar mda' ni byang du blta: de lta bu yi lung phu na: ldang lha zhes bya'i brag ri ni: nag po kha ni nub tu blta: de mdun brag bod gsum yod de: bo do gsum gyi dbus ma la: rin chen chos kyi gter sgo ni: mkha' 'gro snying thig ces bya ba'i: skad cig rig pa mngon sum gyi: snang ba 'phral du tshad phyin yod: 'di 'dra'i gdams pa rgya bod gnyis na med:

'di ni las can cig dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ༄༅: ཿbtags grol skor la ma bu nyi shu gsum: dbang gi skor la ma bu nyi shu gsum: khrid kyi skor la ma bu rnam pa lnga: rgyab chos skor la ma lnga bu bzhi 'o: bar do ma gnyis bu gsum dag gis rdzogs: thams cad mdor dril drug cu rtsa lnga yis: mkha' 'gro snying thig gdams pa ma lus 'grub: de yi bka' srung srog sgrub nag mo la: cha rkyen drug gi de nyid lhag chad med: skal ldan dang 'phrad lhag med 'grub par shog: rgya rgya rgya: sprul sku rong ban gyis gdan drangs pa'o: athi+-i: ཿ mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (5)mkha' 'gro snying thig gi kha byang*/ -PAGE 2--PAGE 5--PAGE 1-
